long_biography.plain_text:
Two Black Sea venues anchor Ednari Papunaishvili's hospitality business in Batumi. Through GTM Hospitality Group, he controls G17, a restaurant and events space on the city's seafront. Khidi-2006, another wholly owned company, holds the long lease behind Sanremo, where a large restaurant and hospitality redevelopment was planned. His wider company network includes Georgian construction and investment entities, placing property development alongside venue operations.

Papunaishvili's activities also extend into public service. He serves as honorary consul of Kyrgyzstan for Samegrelo-Zemo Svaneti, based in Poti. At the opening of the consular office in 2023, he framed its purpose around trade, investment, tourism, cultural exchange and support for Kyrgyz citizens. He works from a commercial base in western Georgia while the consular office handles cross-border economic and civic matters.
